name: Tsumugi Sara
source:
Another long-time friend of [url=/c50107]Shun's[/url] whom has possessed a genius intellect from a young age, and a scientist involved in android development. 

People tend to think of her as a cold-hearted person since she loves experimenting, but she is actually kind at heart. Although she is the same age as Shun, she is much more mentally mature and sometimes toys around with him.

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190508053003/https://www.mangagamer.com/detail.php?goods_type=1&product_code=1113]MangaGamer[/url]]
